defect.proposed_fix: Limit this assertion to case identity/citation only, or complete treatment/progeny verification before treating the authority as live/current law.

reasons: Lake identity and citations confirm California v. Trombetta and 467 U.S. 479, but the currency question is not verified.

The progeny section has complete_query null, indexed_citing_opinions null, and rows_cached 0, so there is no disclosed citator basis for live-law status.
residual_risks: A completed citator/progeny pass may later confirm the case remains live law, but that evidence is not disclosed here.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Separate identity/citation existence from any live-law implication until treatment is promoted.
